descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Air Combat puts you in the seat of a modern fighter jet, and this time you are armed.

YOUR SQUADRON HANGAR
Start on the hangar floor with your ground crew around the jet. The crew chief salutes, you climb the stairs, and on the runway the canopy closes over your head.

LOCK ON. FIRE.
Hold a bandit in front of you until the diamond turns red, then let a heat-seeking missile go. Inside a kilometre, switch to the cannon: real tracer rounds, a gunsight and a lead ring that shows you where to aim.

EIGHT SORTIES
First Blood, Scramble, Escort Flight 417, Wolfpack, Bomber Raid, Ace of Aces, Night Raid and Last Stand. Each one scored with stars.

PROTECT THE AIRLINER
Ride on a passenger jet's wing across the island while three waves of attackers come for it. Get between them and Flight 417.

FIGHT BESIDE A WINGMAN
In Wolfpack your wingman takes on four bandits with you.

WHEN YOU ARE HIT, EJECT
Hits are felt in your hands, the airframe smokes, an engine catches fire, and the jet's voice tells you to get out. Hold B: the seat fires, your jet explodes ahead of you and your parachute opens above your head.

A WHOLE ISLAND
Mountains, a harbour city, seven airports and a tropical sea, by day, at sunset or at night.

COMFORT
Smooth, eased controls. The cockpit never shakes. A comfort vignette in hard turns.
